verdict.rationale: Checkout.com is API-first with SDKs (e.g. Node.js), OAuth2 client-credentials auth, idempotent retries, webhooks, and a full sandbox/test-account environment with test cards — all of which support scripted, headless use in CI/test pipelines. However there is no dedicated CLI or explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation/tutorials for automation. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI tool, explicit CI/CD integration guide or example pipeline.
